hono.dev:698: Middleware concept in Hono: Handler returns Response. Middleware executes before and after Handler with onion/layered structure. Middleware handles Request and Response. hono.dev:699: Philosophy and concept of Hono: motivation for creating fast, versatile web framework. Works on multiple platforms (Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun). Uses Web Standard APIs only. Ecosystem includes GraphQL servers, Firebase auth, Sentry middleware, Node.js adapter. Goal is becoming Standard for Web Standards.
hono.dev:700: Motivation: needed good framework for Cloudflare Workers. Learned Trie tree router building. Friend created RegExpRouter ultra-fast router. Friend created Basic auth middleware. Web Standard APIs enabled Deno/Bun support. Ecosystem grew with GraphQL, Firebase, Sentry contributions. Became answer to 'is there Express for Bun?'. Goal: damn fast, makes many things possible, works anywhere, become Standard for Web Standards.
hono.dev:701: Routers are most important Hono features. Five routers available: RegExpRouter (fastest using single large regexp), TrieRouter (Trie tree algorithm), SmartRouter (selects best router automatically), LinearRouter (optimized for one-shot, faster registration), PatternRouter (smallest under 15KB). Default SmartRouter uses RegExpRouter+TrieRouter combination. Selection depends on platform and use case.
hono.dev:702: RegExpRouter: fastest JavaScript router. Turns route patterns into one large regular expression for single-time matching. Faster than radix-tree methods in most cases. Doesn't support all routing patterns, combined with other routers. Doesn't use linear loops or path-to-regexp.
hono.dev:703: TrieRouter: uses Trie-tree algorithm. No linear loops. Not as fast as RegExpRouter but faster than Express router. Supports all routing patterns.
hono.dev:704: SmartRouter: selects best router automatically. Hono default uses SmartRouter with RegExpRouter and TrieRouter. When app starts, detects fastest router based on registered routes.
hono.dev:705: LinearRouter: optimized for one-shot request initialization. Route registration faster than RegExpRouter (no string compilation). Benchmark: 1.82 µs/iter vs MedleyRouter 4.44, FindMyWay 60.36, KoaTreeRouter 3.81, TrekRouter 5.84 µs/iter. 2.1x faster than KoaTreeRouter, 33.24x faster than FindMyWay.
hono.dev:706: PatternRouter: smallest router for resource-limited environments. Application size under 15KB with only PatternRouter. Total upload 14.68 KiB, gzip 5.38 KiB.

hono.dev:714: Web Standards foundation: Hono uses only Web Standards like Fetch API objects. Includes Request, Response, URL, URLSearchParam, Headers. Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, Fastly Compute built on Web Standards. Hello World example runs same on multiple platforms. Same code runs on Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, Fastly Compute, AWS Lambda, Node.js, Vercel edge-light, WebAssembly WASI, Netlify. WinterCG standardization for web-interoperability.
hono.dev:715: Context object: instantiated per request, lifetime until response returned. Access HonoRequest (c.req) and Response (c.res). Set HTTP status (default 200), headers, response body. Methods: status(), header(), body(), text(), json(), html(), notFound(), redirect(). Store arbitrary key-value pairs (c.set/c.get) per request. Access Cloudflare Workers ExecutionContext, FetchEvent (Service Worker), environment bindings. Error handling with c.error. Render responses with custom layout via c.render/c.setRenderer. Support ContextVariableMap for global type definitions.
hono.dev:716: req: HonoRequest instance providing access to request data and methods. See HonoRequest API documentation.
hono.dev:717: status(): set HTTP status code. Default 200 if not specified. Example: c.status(201) for created response.
hono.dev:718: header(): set response HTTP headers. Multiple header() calls set individual headers.
hono.dev:719: body(): return HTTP response body. Recommend c.text() or c.html() for text/HTML. Can set Content-Type header. Accepts body, status code, header object parameters.
hono.dev:720: text(): render text response with Content-Type: text/plain.
hono.dev:721: json(): render JSON response with Content-Type: application/json. Pass object as parameter.
hono.dev:722: html(): render HTML response with Content-Type: text/html. Pass HTML string as parameter.
hono.dev:723: notFound(): return 404 Not Found response. Customizable with app.notFound().
hono.dev:724: redirect(): redirect to specified path. Default status 302, can specify status code (e.g., 301 permanent).
hono.dev:725: res: access Response object that will be returned. Append headers with c.res.headers.append().
hono.dev:726: set() / get(): store and retrieve arbitrary key-value pairs with request lifetime. Enable passing values between middleware and handlers. Types defined in Hono generic: type Variables { key: type }. Values retained only within same request, cannot persist across requests.
hono.dev:727: var: access variable values with c.var.name instead of c.get(). Create middleware providing custom methods. Use createMiddleware with Env type. Pass Env generics to Hono constructor for type safety.
hono.dev:728: render() / setRenderer(): set layout for responses. Use c.setRenderer() in middleware with custom renderer function. c.render() creates responses within layout. Supports custom arguments with ContextRenderer module augmentation. Example: page layout with header, title, content.
hono.dev:729: executionCtx: access Cloudflare Workers ExecutionContext. Use c.executionCtx.waitUntil() for background tasks. Module augmentation for exports field with Cloudflare.Exports type.
hono.dev:730: event: access Cloudflare Workers FetchEvent. Used in Service Worker syntax (deprecated). Call c.event.waitUntil() for background operations. Not recommended for new code.
hono.dev:731: env: access Cloudflare Workers bindings (variables, secrets, KV namespaces, D1 database, R2 bucket). Define Bindings type with keys. Access as c.env.BINDING_KEY. Always available as global variables.
hono.dev:732: error: access error object if Handler throws. Check c.error in middleware after next(). Used for error handling in app.onError.
hono.dev:733: ContextVariableMap: augment interface to define context variables globally. Types applied globally regardless of middleware registration. Warning: can hide undefined bugs if variable not guaranteed in all handlers. Use Env's Variables generic for safe per-handler typing instead.
hono.dev:734: HTTPException: custom Hono Error for fatal errors, simplifies error responses. Throw with status code and message or custom response. Use cause option for arbitrary error data. Handle uncaught HTTPExceptions with app.onError() using instanceof check and getResponse() method. Returns Response created from status and message/custom response. Warning: getResponse not Context-aware, must manually apply Context headers to response.
hono.dev:735: Throwing HTTPExceptions: new HTTPException(status, options). Basic: { message: string } for text responses. Custom response: { res: Response } for other types/headers. Cause option: { cause: any } for arbitrary error data.
hono.dev:739: Handling HTTPExceptions: use app.onError(err, c). Check instanceof HTTPException. Call err.getResponse() to return generated Response. For other errors, log and return generic 500. Warning: getResponse() lacks Context awareness - manually apply Context headers to new Response if needed.
hono.dev:740: Hono primary object: instantiated first, used throughout application lifecycle. Export as default for Cloudflare Workers or Bun. Methods: HTTP_METHOD (get/post/put/delete), all(), on(), use(), route(), basePath(), notFound(), onError(), mount(), fire(), fetch(), request(). Constructor options: strict mode (default true), router selection, generics for type safety. Supports Cloudflare Workers bindings and variables via generic types.
hono.dev:741: Methods list: app.get/post/put/delete/patch([path], handler/middleware...), app.all([path], handler), app.on(method/method[], path/path[], handler), app.use([path], middleware), app.route(path, [app]), app.basePath(path), app.notFound(handler), app.onError(handler), app.mount(path, app, [options]), app.fire(), app.fetch(request, env, event), app.request(path, options). See routing section for details.
hono.dev:742: notFound: customize Not Found response. Takes handler returning custom 404 response. Only called from top-level app. See issue #3465 for nested app behavior.
hono.dev:743: onError: handle uncaught errors with custom response. Takes error and context, returns Response. If both parent and route handlers present, route-level priority.
hono.dev:744: fire(): deprecated, use fire() from hono/service-worker instead. Automatically adds global fetch event listener. Executes addEventListener('fetch', event handler). Used for Service Worker API environments, not-recommended for module workers.
hono.dev:745: fetch: entry point returning Response. Cloudflare Workers: return app.fetch(request, env, ctx). Can export app directly or wrap in fetch handler object. Bun: export object with port and fetch property.
hono.dev:746: request: testing method. Pass URL/pathname for GET, returns Response. Pass Request object for custom method/body. Useful for unit tests.
hono.dev:747: mount: mount other framework apps. Takes path, app/handler, optional options object. Default creates new Request with mount path removed. replaceRequest option controls Request passed: function for custom logic, false for original unchanged.
hono.dev:748: strict mode: default true distinguishes /hello and /hello/. get('/hello') matches only /hello not /hello/. Set strict: false in constructor to treat both equally.
hono.dev:749: router option: specify which router to use in constructor. Default SmartRouter. Pass RegExpRouter/TrieRouter/LinearRouter/PatternRouter for specific behavior.
hono.dev:750: Generics: pass Bindings and Variables types to Hono<>() for type safety. Bindings for Cloudflare Workers environment bindings (KV, D1, R2). Variables for c.set/c.get values. Enable autocomplete and type checking.
hono.dev:751: API overview: Hono's simple API composed from Web Standards. Introduction to Hono object, routing, Context object, middleware. Quick understanding possible.
hono.dev:752: Presets: Hono provides routers for specific purposes. Constructor accepts router option. Presets handle common use cases without manual specification. All presets export same Hono class, only router differs. Interchangeable usage. Three presets: hono (default SmartRouter), hono/quick (LinearRouter+TrieRouter), hono/tiny (PatternRouter only).
hono.dev:753: hono preset: import from 'hono'. Uses SmartRouter with RegExpRouter and TrieRouter. Recommended for most use cases.
hono.dev:754: hono/quick preset: import from 'hono/quick'. Uses SmartRouter with LinearRouter and TrieRouter. Designed for initialization per request.
hono.dev:755: hono/tiny preset: import from 'hono/tiny'. Uses PatternRouter only. Smallest router for resource-limited environments.
hono.dev:756: Preset selection table: hono for Deno/Bun/Node.js long-life servers, Fastly Compute, Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy. hono/quick for per-request initialization environments. hono/tiny for limited resource environments.
hono.dev:757: HonoRequest: wraps Request object, accessible from c.req. Provides methods for accessing request data: param(), query(), queries(), header(), parseBody(), json(), text(), arrayBuffer(), blob(), formData(), valid(). Properties: routePath (deprecated), matchedRoutes (deprecated), path, url, method, raw. Clone request with cloneRawRequest() after body consumed. Single file upload to body['foo'], multiple use body['foo[]'], all option for multiple fields, dot notation for structured parsing.
hono.dev:758: param(): get path parameter value or all params. c.req.param('id') returns single, c.req.param() returns all as object.
hono.dev:759: query(): get querystring parameter value or all params. c.req.query('q') returns single, c.req.query() returns all as object.
hono.dev:760: queries(): get multiple querystring values for same key. c.req.queries('tags') returns string[] for /search?tags=A&tags=B.
hono.dev:761: header(): get request header value. c.req.header('User-Agent') gets single header. c.req.header() without args returns all headers with lowercase keys. Must use exact case for uppercase headers.
hono.dev:762: parseBody(): parse multipart/form-data or application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Single file: body['foo'] is (string | File), last uploaded used. Multiple files: body['foo[]'] always (string | File)[]. all option parses multiple fields with same name. dot option structures output with dot notation.
hono.dev:771: valid(): get validated data from middleware validators. Targets: form, json, query, header, cookie, param. See validation guide for usage.
hono.dev:772: routePath: deprecated in v4.8.0, use routePath() from Route Helper. Returns registered path like /posts/:id.
hono.dev:773: matchedRoutes: deprecated in v4.8.0, use matchedRoutes() from Route Helper. Returns matched routes for debugging with handler name, method, path.
hono.dev:775: url: full request URL string, e.g., http://localhost:8787/about/me.
hono.dev:776: method: HTTP method string, e.g., GET.
hono.dev:777: raw: raw Request object from Fetch API. For Cloudflare Workers access c.req.raw.cf?.hostMetadata?.
hono.dev:778: cloneRawRequest(): clone raw Request object after body consumption. Works after validators/methods consumed body. Enables reading body multiple times.
hono.dev:779: Routing: flexible and intuitive path matching. HTTP methods: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH/all(). Path patterns: static, dynamic :param, optional :param?, regexp :param{pattern}, wildcard *, including slashes. Chaining methods on same path. Grouping routes with route(). Base path prefix. Hostname-based routing. Priority: registration order matters, handlers stop execution. Middleware must come before handlers. Fallback routes at end. Strict mode default true distinguishes /hello and /hello/.
hono.dev:780: Basic routing: app.get/post/put/delete/patch/query/all(path, handler). Wildcard /wild/*/card. Custom methods app.on('PURGE'). Multiple methods app.on(['PUT','DELETE']). Multiple paths app.on('GET', [paths]).
hono.dev:781: Path parameters: app.get('/user/:name', (c) => c.req.param('name')). Get all: c.req.param() returns { name, ... }.
hono.dev:782: Optional parameters: :param? matches with and without value. app.get('/api/animal/:type?', ...) matches /api/animal and /api/animal/:type.
hono.dev:784: Including slashes: :filename{.+\.png} for paths containing slashes.
hono.dev:785: Chained route: app.get(path, (c) => ...).post((c) => ...).delete((c) => ...) handles same path with multiple methods.
hono.dev:786: Grouping: create Hono instance for routes, add to main app with app.route(path, subapp). Enables modular route organization.
hono.dev:787: Grouping without changing base: route paths as full paths in subapp, add to main app with app.route('/', subapp). Handles multiple bases.
hono.dev:788: Base path: app.basePath('/api') prefix all routes. app.get('/book') becomes GET /api/book.

hono.dev:791: Routing priority: handlers execute in registration order. First match stops execution. Middleware before handler, fallback handler at end. Specific routes before generic patterns.
hono.dev:792: Grouping ordering: route() adds stored routing to current app. Correct order required: subapp routes must be registered before main app.route(). Incorrect order returns 404.
